Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning mitigation fees for traffic impacts imposed under the state environmental policy act.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to mitigation fees for traffic impacts imposedunder the state environmental policy act; and adding a new section tochapter 43.21C RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.21C RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Cities may impose mitigation fees for traffic impacts under thischapter for proposals located outside of their jurisdictionalboundaries only if the city imposing the fee or fees has an agreementunder chapter 39.34 RCW with the county or city within which theproposal is located governing the terms by which the fees may beimposed.
